primary_estimator: D1 balanced: nonempty donor days; equal days within bird and equal other birds; exact shared 5-km target cells; exclude same-date donors; day-median centered height; >=50 scored events/day, >=2 days/bird, >=10 birds
recovery: First attempt parsed source heights but failed at first JIT cache load before emitting an identity statistic. Only production cache isolation changed; source, algorithm, thresholds and seed did not. See DELTATRACK_2021_RUNTIME_RECOVERY_V1.json.
interpretation: A prospectively specified external tracking-study test supports individual-label-associated cross-day centered altitude shape in L. fuscus. L. argentatus is unavailable, not a negative biological replication.
boundaries: This is external relative to MEDGULL; not a new independent DELTATRACK study for every year.
The two DELTATRACK species share site and instrument context; do not count them as two fully independent studies.
Exact-date permutation preserves dates but still assumes exchangeability; null support counts differ from observed support counts.
Tag-specific non-additive errors, sampling effort, behavioral mixtures and within-cell horizontal routes remain potential contributors.
37/40 positive scores are descriptive, not 37 separately significant individual tests.
D50 and pooled comparisons are descriptive; their raw signs do not replace the calibrated prespecified primary.
No inference of adaptive resource partitioning, central-place causation or universal mammal-bird equivalence.
Original MEDGULL n=9 and DELTATRACK 2020 failures remain closed and unchanged.
